Psalms 125:2 MSG
Mountains encircle Jerusalem, and God encircles his people – always has and always will.
?
You are a people encircled or surrounded by God Himself.
?No weapon formed against you will prosper.
?Evil and the evil one will be kept far from you.
?There shall be no breaking in
?Noise of terror will be far from you.
?Every evil plan against you will be defeated in Jesus name
